statement.en: From the member on whom every later member reads only the acts before it, a pool's acts are alike across worlds alike through the earlier members' couplings: it reaches only what couples into those read first, however many follow.
statement.zh: 自其后每一成员唯读其前之行者起，池之行于前者耦合无别之二世界皆同：其所及唯在先所读者之所耦合入，后继者多寡不论。

laws.en: Members act in turn: member n by its law on its own coupling of the world and the list of the acts before it; from member k on, every member acting alike whatever its coupling, and two worlds alike through the couplings of the members before k, are named.
laws.zh: 成员依次而行：第 n 员依其律，于其对世界之耦合及其前之行之列而行；自第 k 员起每员不论其耦合皆同行，及于第 k 员前诸员之耦合无别之二世界，皆有名。

laws.en: From member k on, where every member reads only the acts before it, two worlds alike through the couplings of the members before k give every member the same act, and the same list of acts at every length.
laws.zh: 自第 k 员起每员唯读其前之行，则于第 k 员前诸员之耦合无别之二世界，每员之行皆同，每一长之行列皆同。

laws.en: So every selection reading the list of the first N acts, for any N, selects alike any two worlds alike through the couplings of the members before k.
laws.zh: 故凡读首 N 行之列之选，不论 N，于第 k 员前诸员之耦合无别之二世界皆同选。

laws.en: After the same earlier acts, a member acts differently in two worlds exactly where its law tells apart the values they give its coupling.
laws.zh: 前行相同之后，一员于二世界行异，恰当其律分二世界予其耦合之值。

laws.en: Copying: the first member acts on its own coupling and every later one copies the first act before it; it is a cascade from the second member, and two worlds alike through the first member's coupling give every member the same act.
laws.zh: 相仿：首员依其耦合而行，其后每员仿其前之首行；此自第二员起为级联，于首员之耦合无别之二世界，每员之行皆同。

hypotheses.en: Any types of worlds, couplings and acts; members indexed by the natural numbers, each reading the whole list of acts before it.
hypotheses.zh: 世界、耦合与行之任一型；成员以自然数为序，各读其前之全部行列。

hypotheses.en: From member k on, every member acts alike whatever its own coupling; member k's coupling is then not read, so it is not among those the acts reach.
hypotheses.zh: 自第 k 员起每员不论其耦合皆同行；故第 k 员之耦合不为所读，不在诸行所及之中。

does_not_show.en: When an actual member stops reading its own coupling: in the probabilistic model, once the public evidence outweighs any private signal, which is a premise here.
does_not_show.zh: 实际之员何时不复读其耦合：于概率之模型，公示之据重于任一私讯之时；此处为前提。

does_not_show.en: That a cascade errs: it suppresses what later members' couplings carry, and can be accurate.
does_not_show.zh: 级联必误：其抑后员之耦合所载者，可为准。

does_not_show.en: That a pool's later selection keeps a coupling one member's act carries.
does_not_show.zh: 池之后选存一员之行所载之耦合。

does_not_show.en: Weighted averaging (DeGroot) and its wisdom condition, networks where members read only some earlier acts, and members in no well-founded order.
does_not_show.zh: 加权平均（DeGroot）及其智之条件，成员唯读部分前行之网，及无良基之序之成员。

detail.en: Copying: worlds differing in every member's coupling but the first give every member the same act (Turns.Copying.reaches_first_only).
detail.zh: 相仿：除首员外每员之耦合皆异之二世界，每员之行皆同（Turns.Copying.reaches_first_only）。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, every axiom report empty: Cascade imports Learning for Training.Through only; the acts are built by recursion on the number of members.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核，公理报告皆空：Cascade 引 Learning 唯为 Training.Through；诸行以成员之数递归而建。

next_delta.en: The probabilistic form, a cascade once public evidence outweighs every private signal; a test predicting when sequential choosers stop reading their own signals; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 概率之形，公示之据重于每一私讯时之级联；预测依次之择者何时不复读其私讯之检验；人之审查。

correspondence.en: The deterministic form of an information cascade (Bikhchandani, Hirshleifer and Welch 1992; Banerjee 1992), where the act has stopped reading the member's own signal; the dependence failure of Condorcet's jury theorem; WitnessRefinementRuns.copied_witnesses_same is a neighbour, where copied witnesses add nothing under its further hypotheses. Read as echo chambers or evaluators trained on one another's verdicts, a reading, not a containment.
correspondence.zh: 信息级联之定形（Bikhchandani、Hirshleifer 与 Welch 1992；Banerjee 1992），行已不读员之私讯者；Condorcet 陪审定理之依存之失；WitnessRefinementRuns.copied_witnesses_same 为其邻，其另加诸前提下仿制之证人无所增。读作回声室或以彼此之判而训之评者，为读，非包含。

detail.en: Training.Through, the selection through a relation of being alike.
A pool reaches no further than the union of its members' closures; where members read one another's acts, only what couples into those read first.
detail.zh: 池之所及不逾其诸员之闭包之并；诸员彼此读行之处，唯及在先所读者之所耦合入。

history.en: 29 October 2026: added (RF round 1), readers reading readers: from a cascade on, a pool reaches only the couplings of those read first; a member carrying its coupling; copying; after a review of the plan and a review of the Lean; study section 445.
history.zh: 2026年10月29日：新增（RF 第一轮），读者读读者：自级联起池唯及在先所读者之耦合；载其耦合之员；相仿；经计划之审与 Lean 之审；研究第 445 节。
